verdict.rationale: Aider is itself an AI coding assistant. Its docs show several ways to hand it natural-language tasks: in-chat file editing where it finds the relevant files itself, `/architect` and `/ask` modes, `--message` and Python scripting, `AI!` comments in watch mode, voice instructions, and auto-lint/test after edits. Community users corroborate hands-on delegation to it on real codebases. Missing for 10: a native multi-step autonomous mode (the Claude-Code-style autonomy is a community add-on, 'navigator-mode'), and some hands-on reports of subtle errors in delegated output.
